AccountSummary.description: What the identity port reports about one account of the identity provider: its id, its login name, its email (a service account has none), whether it may sign in, and its global roles.

account_id.description: The identity provider's id of the account.

active.description: Whether the account may sign in; a disabled account is refused new tokens.

email.description: The email address of a person's account.

global_roles.description: The system-level roles the token grants the principal.

user_name.description: The name the account signs in with.

AccountSummary.title: AccountSummary

Action.description: The actions a rule can name.
Action.title: Action

AggregateRoot.description: A mixin for classes whose instances are aggregate roots. Each instance is one named graph, whose IRI is derived from the root's IRI; it is versioned, loaded and saved as a whole.
AggregateRoot.title: AggregateRoot

Any.description: Any value; the slots that range over it hold data the toolkit does not model.
Any.title: Any

Authorised.description: What a route's access check settled: the caller's principal, its access to the tenant, and the IRI of the tenant or aggregate it was checked on, which the route then acts on.

caller_access.description: The caller's access to the tenant, as the access check loaded it.

checked_target.description: The IRI of the aggregate the access check was made on.

principal.description: The user account the token identifies.

Authorised.title: Authorised

CallerAccess.description: What the access check needs to know about one caller in one tenant: the tenant's state, and the grants and prohibitions of the access record that name the caller.

grants.description: The permissions given in the tenant, by role or as direct actions; they live in the access record's graph.

prohibitions.description: The actions forbidden in the tenant; they live in the access record's graph.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

CallerAccess.title: CallerAccess

Condition.description: An equality filter of a listing resolved against the slots of the listed type: the aggregate has this statement. The value is an IRI when it is a reference, else a literal of the datatype.

datatype.description: The IRI of the datatype of a literal value; absent for a plain string.

predicate.description: The IRI of the predicate the aggregate must have a statement with.

reference.description: Whether the value is an IRI rather than a literal.

value.description: The value of the statement, an IRI or the lexical form of a literal.

Condition.title: Condition

DatabaseKind.description: The databases an aggregate can live in, the values of the database annotation.
DatabaseKind.title: DatabaseKind

Described.description: A mixin giving an object an IRI, a label and a description. The application writes them.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

Described.title: Described

Filter.description: One equality filter of a listing, the name of a slot of the listed type and the value it must have, as the text the caller sent.

slot.description: The name of the slot the filter is on.

value.description: The value the slot must have, as text.

Filter.title: Filter

Grant.description: A permission given to a principal on a tenant or on one aggregate, either by role or as a direct action; exactly one of role and action is given.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

role.description: The name of a role, matched against the application's role definitions.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Grant.title: Grant

GrantSet.description: The body that replaces the grants and prohibitions of a tenant; two grants with the same assignee, target and role or action are refused.

grants.description: The permissions given in the tenant, by role or as direct actions; they live in the access record's graph.

prohibitions.description: The actions forbidden in the tenant; they live in the access record's graph.

GrantSet.title: GrantSet

GraphKind.description: The special graphs a class can live in, the values of the graph annotation.
GraphKind.title: GraphKind

LabelUpdate.description: The body that replaces the label of a tenant.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

LabelUpdate.title: LabelUpdate

ListPlan.description: A listing resolved against the slots of the listed type: the class, the typed conditions, the predicate to order by (none orders by IRI), the page, and the graphs of the aggregates the caller may not read.

conditions.description: The equality conditions of a listing; all of them must hold.

hidden_graphs.description: The IRIs of the graphs of the aggregates a listing leaves out.

limit.description: The most objects the page can hold.

offset.description: The position of the page's first object in the whole listing.

sort_by.description: The IRI of the predicate a listing is ordered by; absent, it is ordered by IRI.

target.description: The IRI of the class of the aggregates listed.

ListPlan.title: ListPlan

ListRequest.description: The query of a listing, as the caller sent it: the equality filters, the position and size of the page and the key to sort by.

filters.description: The equality filters of a listing; all of them must hold.

limit.description: The most objects the page can hold.

offset.description: The position of the page's first object in the whole listing.

sort.description: The slot a listing is ordered by, ascending, or descending when its name starts with a minus sign; absent, the listing is ordered by IRI.

ListRequest.title: ListRequest

ModuleKind.description: The kinds of schema module, the values of the module_kind annotation.
ModuleKind.title: ModuleKind

Page.description: One page of a listing, with the position of the page in the whole listing.

items.description: The objects of the page; framed aggregates, or tenant summaries.

limit.description: The most objects the page can hold.

offset.description: The position of the page's first object in the whole listing.

total.description: The number of objects in the whole listing.

Page.title: Page

Policy.description: A set of permissions and prohibitions.
Policy.title: Policy

Principal.description: A reference to a user account in the identity provider, by IRI only.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

Principal.title: Principal

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem detail, the body of every error answer of the service.

detail.description: An explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: The IRI that identifies this occurrence of the problem.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the answer.

title.description: A short, fixed summary of the kind of problem.

type.description: The IRI that identifies the kind of problem.

Problem.title: Problem

ProblemKind.description: A kind of problem the service answers with: the slug that ends its problem type IRI, its fixed title and the HTTP status it comes with.

slug.description: The last segment of the problem type IRI, lower case words joined by hyphens.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the answer.

title.description: A short, fixed summary of the kind of problem.

ProblemKind.title: ProblemKind

ProblemSlug.description: The kinds of problem the toolkit answers with, by the last segment of their problem type IRI, with the underscores written as hyphens.
ProblemSlug.title: ProblemSlug

Prohibition.description: The ODRL prohibition that forbids an assignee an action on a target; it wins over any permission.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Prohibition.title: Prohibition

RegistryEntry.description: An entry of a tenant's registry graph, naming a graph that belongs to an aggregate. It is written by the session, never by the application.

graph.description: The IRI of a named graph.

kind.description: The kind of graph a registry entry names.

owned_by.description: The IRI of the aggregate root that owns the graph.

RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry

RegistryKind.description: The kinds of graph a registry entry can name.
RegistryKind.title: RegistryKind

RoleDefinition.description: What a role may do and where it applies. An application supplies its role definitions as data; they are not stored.

role.description: The name of a role, matched against the application's role definitions.

RoleDefinition.title: RoleDefinition

RoleLevel.description: The levels at which a role applies.
RoleLevel.title: RoleLevel

RpAnnotation.description: The annotations the toolkit reads from a schema, one entry per tag; any other tag is left alone. Each description says which element carries the tag and which values it accepts.
RpAnnotation.title: RpAnnotation

Rule.description: An ODRL rule that gives an assignee a ruling on an action over a target.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Rule.title: Rule

ServiceSettings.description: The settings of `install_service`: where the service is mounted, how it names tenants and which role its callers get on a tenant they create.

base.description: The IRI under which the service mints identifiers and problem types, ending in a slash.

creator_role.description: The role a caller is given on the tenant it creates.

max_body_bytes.description: The most bytes a request body may hold; a larger one is refused with 413 before it is read whole.

prefix.description: The prefix of the database names of the service's tenants; lower case, at most 20 characters.

roles_claim.description: The claim of the token that holds the caller's global roles, an object keyed by role name; for Zitadel, urn:zitadel:iam:org:project:{project_id}:roles of the consumer's project.

tenant_segment.description: The path segment that names the tenant collection in the service's routes.

ServiceSettings.title: ServiceSettings

TenantAccess.description: The access record of a tenant: its label, state and database name, with the grants and prohibitions that say who may do what in it.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

grants.description: The permissions given in the tenant, by role or as direct actions; they live in the access record's graph.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

prohibitions.description: The actions forbidden in the tenant; they live in the access record's graph.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

TenantAccess.title: TenantAccess

TenantCreate.description: The body that creates a tenant, its label and the slots of the tenant's root object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

root.description: The slots of the tenant's root object, as the application's schema defines them.

TenantCreate.title: TenantCreate

TenantLabelled.description: A mixin for what carries a tenant's label, one line of 1 to 200 characters that neither starts nor ends in a space; the access record and the service's request bodies share it, so the label is checked the same everywhere.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

TenantLabelled.title: TenantLabelled

TenantSummary.description: What the service answers about one tenant, in a listing or after creating it.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

TenantSummary.title: TenantSummary

Tracked.description: A mixin for the tracking statements of a commit. The session writes them about the aggregate's graph IRI, never about the root entity.
Tracked.title: Tracked

VerifiedCaller.description: What a token verifier returns for a valid token, the principal and its global roles.

global_roles.description: The system-level roles the token grants the principal.

principal.description: The user account the token identifies.

VerifiedCaller.title: VerifiedCaller
